subject: Re: PoC Trial Plan & Deployment Mode - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme-corp.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: Next steps - PoC focus + deployment mode

Thanks for the call today - quick recap from our side and a request for a proposed PoC/trial plan.

High-level notes from our discovery:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for customer-facing search & chat features (target 95p latency < 250ms for 1k qps peak).
- Cost sensitivity: want to understand unit economics for hosted vs dedicated.
- Data controls: some data is PII and governed by our compliance team; we may require VPC-private endpoints or an on-prem option for certain workloads.
- Stakeholders: myself (SRE/Product), Liam O'Neill (Head of ML), and Procurement (procurement@acme-corp.com).

Request: can Redwood propose a PoC/trial plan that compares Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, and a Private VPC option? We want: success criteria, timeline, required stakeholders/contacts, and any pre-reqs (SOC 2 evidence, network setup, estimated costs).

Thanks - Sofia

--
Sofia Alvarez
Senior Product Manager, Search
Acme Corp
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps - PoC focus + deployment mode

Hi Sofia - great speaking with you and Liam yesterday. Appreciate the clear priorities. Attached is an initial PoC plan that lays out three parallel tracks (Hosted API quick trial, Dedicated reserved capacity evaluation, and Private VPC trial). High-level summary below and next steps.

PoC summary (short):
- Hosted API track: quickest time-to-value. We'll run a 2-week trial using a representative traffic replay and a small test corpus. Success = matching 95p latency < 250ms under your 1k qps profile and acceptable output quality (sample prompts).
- Dedicated track: reserved GPU pool with predictable throughput. We'll configure a 2-4 week test window, estimate throughput and token cost, and validate autoscaling/burst behavior. Success = sustained throughput target with stability and <15% cost delta vs hosted during comparable load.
- Private VPC track: we'll stand up a private endpoint in your VPC (or use an on-prem package for air-gapped needs). This requires network setup and a short security review. Success = compliance checklist satisfied (KMS integration, audit logs) and latency/throughput targets met.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0: finalize scope and sign-off on PoC plan; exchange contact list and required network info.
- Week 1-2: run Hosted API traffic replay and baseline metrics.
- Week 2-4: Dedicated capacity trial (if approved) - throughput and cost testing.
- Week 3-5: Private VPC setup & validation (parallel to Dedicated where possible).

Stakeholders & asks:
- Acme: SRE (network access), ML (Liam), Procurement (PO/contract), Security (for SOC2/VPC review).
- Redwood: Ben (account lead) for contracting and pricing, Marissa (solutions engineer) for test design and infra, Dev Patel (security lead) for SOC2 and network checklist.

Attachments: Redwood PoC plan v1 (redwood-poc-plan-acme-v1.pdf) and SOC 2 summary slide (soc2-summary.pdf). I've also linked a HubSpot deal and a Drive doc with the plan.

Next steps proposed:
1) You confirm the tracks you want to run (we can do Hosted-only to start).
2) If Private/Dedicated are required, please share primary security contact and preferred network windows.
3) We'll schedule a 30m kickoff tech call (Marissa + Dev + your ML/SRE).

Happy to iterate - I’ll loop Ben for commercial details once you confirm which tracks to run.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia@acme-corp.com>

Thanks Jordan - this looks good. A few clarifications from our security and ML teams:
- Security: initial preference is Dedicated capacity for customer-facing production traffic, but we need the Private VPC option for a segment of traffic that includes PII. Can you confirm if Dedicated can be deployed inside our VPC or if that requires the Private option? Also request: SOC 2 Type II report and a short security checklist for the VPC setup.
- ML: Liam asked about model variants and quantization support for cost testing (are there prebuilt quantized variants we can test?).

We'd like to kick off with Hosted API replay next week to get baseline numbers, then run Dedicated evaluation the following two weeks, and parallelize Private VPC work with your security engineer. Procurement (cc'd) will coordinate SOW and PO after we agree on scope.

Can Marissa and Dev be on the kickoff (tech call) the week of Jul 27?

Best,
Sofia
